description: This file contains server-side code for managing a multiple-choice exam in an online examination system. It handles loading questions from a database, displaying them to the user, timing the exam, and processing the submitted answers to calculate and store the score.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Partial class representing the server-side logic for the multiple-choice question exam page in the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; loads questions from database based on session course, sets up timer, or displays alert if no course selected.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the home button is clicked; redirects to dashboard.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the profile button is clicked; redirects to user profile.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the leaderboard button is clicked; redirects to leaderboard.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Processes submitted answers, calculates the score, saves it to the database, and redirects to the results page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Handles the timer tick event; updates remaining time and handles timeout.
